name: blender
instruction: Blender is a 3D application. IMPORTANT: Blender renders its entire UI with OpenGL using custom fonts that OCR CANNOT read. click_text WILL NOT WORK inside Blender's viewport or menus. You MUST use keyboard shortcuts and hotkeys instead. LAUNCH: Use launch action with target 'blender'. OPENING FILES: To open File menu, use hotkey: {"type": "hotkey", "keys": ["alt", "f"]}. Then navigate with arrow keys and Enter. To open a recent file: {"type": "hotkey", "keys": ["alt", "f"]}, then click_text 'Open Recent' or use arrow keys. Or use cmd: {"type": "cmd", "command": "& 'C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 4.2\blender.exe' 'C:\path\to\file.blend'"}. SPLASH SCREEN: Click anywhere outside the splash to dismiss it. For recent files on splash, use coordinate click based on the grid. MENUS: File=Alt+F, Edit=Alt+E. KEY SHORTCUTS: Tab=Edit/Object mode, Shift+A=Add menu, G=Move, R=Rotate, S=Scale, X=Delete, Ctrl+Z=Undo, Numpad0=Camera, F12=Render. NAVIGATION: Middle-mouse=Orbit, Scroll=Zoom, Shift+Middle=Pan. N-PANEL: Press N to toggle the right side panel (where Sollumz tools are). CRITICAL: Never use click_text for Blender UI elements. Always prefer keyboard shortcuts or coordinate-based click with the grid.
